'''Hoverdollies''' were devices used to transport objects while being pulled by a moving individual. When the [[Ramoan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bazel Warv]], who was suffering from [[Force psychosis]], was secretly smuggled out of the [[new Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] suffering the illness in [[43 ABY]], [[Gender/Legends|his]] fellow Knights [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]] flanked the group carrying him while pulling hoverdollies loaded with [[olbio tree]]s and [[Ysalamiri/Legends|Ysalamiri]]. Both [[Species/Legends|species]] were capable of suppressing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and were present to prevent the Ramoan using it to fight the [[Spice/Legends|drugs]] keeping him sedated.<ref name="Ab" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hoverdollies first appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' written by [[Troy Denning]] as the third novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
